episodes.198957: A strong upper level low moved into the area. On the back side of this low is a strong upper level jet which enhanced area showers. Wash outs and slides were disruptive and destructive to the public.

events.narrative: Heavy rains lead to flooding about 2 miles northeast of Ferndale, CA. This lead to the closing of Coffee Creek Road in its entirety. Lat. 40.60N, Long. -124.23W.
